_comment: The WASM render boundary's request encoding, pinned (#223). NOT Factorio ground truth - this is our own ABI, so it has no game version, which is why PROVENANCE.json declares it under notFixtures. It IS read by a spec: test/wasmFulgoraRenderParity.spec.ts asserts src/noise/wasm/request.ts writes exactly these bytes. The layout is in crates/fmw-wasm/src/abi.rs. These bytes were verified by an INDEPENDENT decoder - a Python struct.unpack against the layout table, not the TypeScript writer under test - which agreed on all 17 fields, read the magic back as ASCII 'FMWR', and matched all four trig values exactly. Regenerating them from the encoder would make this fixture agree with itself and prove nothing; if the layout changes, bump ABI_VERSION on both sides and re-verify the same way. UPDATED 2026-08-19 for #279: the LAYOUT did not change, so ABI_VERSION stays 1 - only the four trig words at offsets 72/80/88/96 moved, because bearingTrig now narrows every step to f32 to match startingSpotAtAngle. Those four were recomputed in Python from the definition (f32(seed0/360), then f32(f32(a/180)*f32(pi)), then f32(sin)/f32(cos)) and only then compared against the encoder, which agreed on all four - so this stayed an independent check rather than becoming a regeneration. Every other byte is untouched from #223.
